name: Eskibeat click-clack
desc: Wiley-school eskibeat at 140: halftime kick on the one and the and-of-two, the click-clack double rim answering on beat three, and cold spacey ViscoSpaceDrum perc blips in the gaps — Bow E3, winter 2002. Sparse is nearly empty air; peak brings clap layers and double kicks.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ ~ ~ ~ [rim rim] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.65).room(.3), s("~ ~ <mt ~ ht ~> ~ ~ ~ <~ lt> ~").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").speed(${spacespd}).gain(${gain}*.4).pan("<.3 .7>"), s("[~ hh]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.25).hpf(6000)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd]>").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ ~ ~ ~ [rim,cp] [~ rim] ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.3), s("~ <mt ht> <ht ~> ~ ~ <lt ~> ~ <~ mt>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").speed(${spacespd}).gain(${gain}*.45).pan("<.25 .75>"), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.3 .18]*2").hpf(5500)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
